name: one sec
title: one-sec.app
shortDescription: one sec helps users manage their time on social media by creating intentional pauses before app usage. It's designed for individuals who find themselves frequently distracted by social media, offering a moment to reconsider the necessity of opening an app. Example use: When attempting to open Instagram, one sec prompts a pause, allowing the user to reflect if they really need to scroll or if it was just an impulsive action.
pros: Reduces social media usage by 57% on average
Promotes mental health by reducing depression and anxiety symptoms
Offers healthy alternatives to replace bad habits
cons: May be perceived as intrusive or annoying
Requires consistent user engagement to be effective
Potential privacy concerns if not handled properly
